description: Build a link that opens this idea in the full Draftlytic app (free account, no card), which runs its own guided flow: AI-tailored questions, full project generation, an editable structured spec, and PRD export (plus scan-for-gaps, logo drafts, and GitHub push on paid plans). Pass either the spec drafted here (it gets compressed into a starting brief) or a plain-text idea. Show the returned URL to the user as a clickable link — this tool only builds it; nothing is sent anywhere.

idea.description: Plain-text idea to hand off when there is no spec yet.

spec.description: A spec object (may be partial) to compress into the handoff brief. Takes precedence over `idea`.
